outcome: sociodemographic profile of children with ASD
clinical profile of children with ASD
ASD diagnosis (in relation to risk factors)
cohort: The study included 180 children aged 2-9 years who were previously diagnosed with Autism Spectrum Disorder using the INCLEN tool based on DSM-V criteria, recruited from five multidisciplinary child developmental centers in Delhi NCR.
finding: The study revealed that children with ASD in the Delhi NCR region were frequently male, from nuclear families, and had highly educated parents, while also detailing their clinical profile including symptom severity and common comorbidities like sleep and behavioral problems.
